steps.name: TRX
adds: Big Horn Level 2 Equipment Group: Adds to Level 1: Dual-zone automatic temperature control, remote start system, heated front seats, heated steering wheel, ParkSense front/rear park assist.
Electronic Locking Rear Axle: Allows the driver to lock the rear differential, forcing both rear wheels to turn at the same speed for enhanced off-road traction.

steps.name: Tungsten
adds: Laramie Level 1 Equipment Group: Auto high-beam headlamp control, blind-spot monitoring with rear cross path detection, ParkSense front/rear park assist, rain-sensitive wipers, power tailgate release.
Power Deployable Running Boards: Side steps that automatically extend downwards when any door is opened, and tuck away aerodynamically when doors are closed.

steps.name: Limited
adds: Big Horn Level 1 Equipment Group: 8.4-inch touchscreen display, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power 8-way driver seat, power-adjustable pedals, rear power-sliding window.
Head-Up Display (HUD): Projects vital vehicle data (speed, navigation, gear, speed limits) directly onto the windshield in the driver's line of sight.

steps.name: Laramie Longhorn
adds: Trailer Tow Group: Trailer brake controller, trailer light check, trailer tire pressure monitoring system, class IV receiver hitch, trailer reverse steering control.
Digital Rearview Mirror: LCD monitor built into the rearview mirror that displays a clear, real-time video stream from a rear-facing camera.

steps.name: Laramie
adds: Bed Utility Group: 4 adjustable cargo tie-down hooks, deployable bed step, LED bed lighting, spray-in bedliner.
Trailer Reverse Steering Control: Dashboard-mounted knob that allows the driver to easily steer a trailer while reversing without using the steering wheel.

steps.name: Rebel
adds: Advanced Safety Group: Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Keep Assist, Parallel and Perpendicular Park Assist, Pedestrian Emergency Braking, Surround View Camera System.
Dual-Pane Panoramic Sunroof: Large power sliding glass front panel and fixed glass rear panel providing natural light to both rows of seating.

steps.name: Big Horn
adds: Black Appearance Package: Completely blacked-out exterior, black Ram lettering, completely black interior accents.
Multifunction Tailgate: Tailgate with a 60/40 split that can swing open horizontally up to 88 degrees, or drop down traditionally like a standard tailgate.

steps.name: Lone Star
adds: Off-Road Group: Electronic locking rear differential, heavy-duty shock absorbers, hill descent control, off-road decals, skid plates (front suspension, transfer case, steering gear), tow hooks.
Active-Level Four-Corner Air Suspension: Automatic load leveling and driver-adjustable ride height with 5 modes: Entry/Exit, Aero, Normal, Off-Road 1, and Off-Road 2.

steps.name: Tradesman HFE
adds: Night Edition: Black exterior badging, black grille surround, black wheels (20 or 22-inch), black exhaust tips, dark headlamp bezels.
RamBox Cargo Management System: Illuminated, lockable, drainable storage bins built into the bed side rails; often includes a 115-volt power outlet.

steps.name: Tradesman
adds: Sport Appearance Package: Body-color grille surround, body-color bumpers, body-color door handles, Sport decals, custom interior themes.
33-Gallon Fuel Tank: Increases fuel capacity from the standard 23 or 26 gallons to 33 gallons for extended driving range.
